gen-press-start-2p-gf-alexandria: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs, with bowls that swell only slightly where they are widest. Alexandria steps in with terminals that open wide, a clean, professional foil.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-amiko: Press Start 2P has thins barely lighter than its thicks, and the spacing feels pinned far apart. But Amiko's terminals flick outward like a pair of tongs, which keeps things modern.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-geist: Mystery Quest leaves an open jaw on every curve, with compact ascenders giving it a bookish, nostalgic feel. Geist settles its words into solid, quiet blocks with no accents of weight.
